text:
Beth (PM): Heads up — infra perf regression on embeddings just bubbled up. If we can't stabilize quickly we need a cut decision for MVP today. Customer A is pushing for SSO in pilot which complicates things. Proposed immediate cutlist: tenant analytics, advanced prompt templates, async webhooks. Thoughts?
Ryan (eng): @Beth we can deprioritize webhooks + templates. The embedding p95/p99 spikes are the blocker — latency SLOs are breached under pilot load. Hotfix ETA ~3w if we scope it tight.
Divya (data): Latest numbers: p50 ~240ms -> unchanged, p95 1.2s, p99 1.8s under 150rps. Root cause looks like KV cache churn and large prefix misses. Quick snapshot: `p99: 1.8s, error-rate: 0.3%`
Ryan (eng): Minimal mitigation options: 1) fallback to smaller model variant for MVP traffic (lower quality), 2) offer reserved capacity for the pilot tenant, 3) cut features to reduce request volume. Hotfix would require kernel tweak + rollout testing.
Sara (design): If we remove prompt templates the UX is degraded but tolerable for a narrow pilot. SSO in MVP is high-value for the customer — losing that risks the pilot. :thinking_face:
Kim (ops): Reserved pool is viable short-term. We can carve a dedicated GPU fleet for the pilot for ~2-3 weeks. Need approval on cost delta from finance.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for embeddings-hotfix v1.1 -> canary-2 at 3322115200 :rocket:
Beth (PM): Ok options summary: A) Keep SSO, cut analytics + templates + webhooks, offer reserved pool to customer (no timeline slip) B) Keep all, push MVP by +2–3 weeks for hotfix C) Keep SSO + analytics, cut templates + webhooks, and fallback to smaller model variant for pilot. Vote now — we'll decide and notify execs.
Ryan (eng): My vote: C. Keeps the customer win (SSO) and buys us time to stabilize without reserving fleet. Will need safe fallback for model quality. :+1:
Divya (data): Vote C as well. We can instrument quality delta with small eval set for the pilot to detect regressions.
Kim (ops): Vote B if finance signs reserved pool; otherwise C. Reserved pool ensures SLOs but costs more.
Sara (design): Vote C. We'll ship migration notes so v1 can reintroduce templates with minimal rework.
Beth (PM): Consensus = C. Decision: cut advanced prompt templates + async webhooks from MVP, keep SSO and analytics, fallback to smaller model variant for pilot traffic, no hard launch slip but add a +2 week buffer in roadmap in case of regressions.
Beth (PM): Action items: @Ryan open hotfix PR + fallback config, @Kim price reserved fleet as contingency, @Sara write UX migration note for v1, @Divya add eval set and monitoring hooks, I'll update roadmap and inform Sales + Customer A.
Ryan (eng): Will open PR and config change now. `branch: fix/fallback-3322`
Kim (ops): I'll ping finance and have numbers by EOD.
Sara (design): Filing UX note in Confluence and adding copy for fallback messaging.
Divya (data): Adding dashboard panels for model-quality delta + latency.
Beth (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll post an updated roadmap snippet and send a short note to execs + Sales after we get numbers from Kim. :thumbsup:
